import { type JSXChildren } from '@builder.io/qwik';

import { type NativeContract } from '../../internal/catalog';
export type CoachMarkProps = NativeContract<CoachMarkContract> & {
    children?: JSXChildren;

/** One resumable owner. Real targets and their outlets remain declarative children. */
export declare const CoachMark: import("@builder.io/qwik").Component<CoachMarkProps>;

    targetId: string;
}
/** Place inside the registered boundary immediately after its unchanged native target. */
export declare const CoachMarkOutlet: import("@builder.io/qwik").Component<CoachMarkOutletProps>;
